title: Three-Cornered
summary: THREE'-CORNERED, adjective [three and corner.] 1. Having three corners or angles; as a three-cornered hat. 2. In botany, having three sides, or three prominent longitudinal angles, as a stem.

inlines.v: THREE'-CORNERED, adjective [three and corner.] 1. Having three corners or angles; as a three-cornered hat. 2. In botany, having three sides, or three prominent longitudinal angles, as a stem.
